name: How long do typical general home repair projects take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long do typical general home repair projects take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: Simple repairs like hanging doors, patching minor drywall holes, or replacing molding usually take a few hours to a single day. More complex projects, such as repairing water-damaged bathroom walls, replacing subflooring, or fixing exterior storm damage, can take two to four days or longer due to drying and curing cycles. For example, drywall patching requires multiple coats of joint compound with dedicated drying time between coats before sanding, priming, and painting. HH Remodeling LLC operates with the owner directly on-site to evaluate progress daily, ensuring repairs advance efficiently while allowing proper curing time for drywall mud, tile mortar, and paint.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor repairs take a few hours to a day, while multi-step tasks like drywall patching, subfloor repairs, or tile work require two to four days to allow proper curing.
